core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL lifecycle with LXR-driven cholesterol efflux
name: Lipoprotein particle lifecycle and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodeling, clearance or regulation of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL and the cholesterol efflux/uptake they mediate; unlike the confusables (sitosterolemia ABCG5/8, bile transporters, oxLDL foam-cell uptake) it covers the full particle lifecycle and LXR/ABCA1 efflux.

core: Bacterial pattern-recognition signaling to stress MAP kinases
qualifier: NOD1/2 and NLR sensing via TAK1 to JNK and p38
name: NOD-like receptor signaling to JNK and p38
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2, NLR and ALPK1 sensing of bacterial products (peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide) and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 stress-kinase regulation, distinguishing it from confusables built on TLR/IRAK/TRIF routes to IKK and NF-kB.

qualifier: commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons, SLIT-ROBO repulsion
name: Midline crossing guidance of commissural and retinal axons
rationale: All members concern axon pathfinding decisions at the midline choice point (SLIT-ROBO repulsion, commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons, optic nerve), distinct from confusables centred on ephrin, netrin-DCC, L1 or ROBO intracellular signaling.

qualifier: L1-family CAMs (neurofascin, NrCAM) and ankyrin clustering sodium channels
name: Node of Ranvier assembly via L1-family CAMs and ankyrin
rationale: Members describe neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin interactions, sodium channel clustering and paranodal junctions that build nodes for action potential propagation, unlike confusables on other neural adhesion, gap junctions or myelination per se.

qualifier: synapse assembly (agrin proteoglycans, dystrophin complex) and presynaptic choline uptake
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular synapse assembly and choline uptake
rationale: Members concern acetylcholine supply (choline transport, SLC5A7) and neuromuscular junction assembly (AChR clustering, DGC, ECM proteoglycans), whereas confusables centre on nicotinic receptor channels, clostridial toxins or glycosylation-linked myasthenic syndromes.

qualifier: viral and microbial modulation
name: Necroptosis and its viral or microbial modulation
rationale: All three members concern necroptotic (RIPK1-driven regulated necrosis) signaling and its manipulation by microbes or SARS-CoV-1, distinguishing it from pyroptosis/inflammasome and caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: social, parental, mating and exploratory
name: Innate social, parental and exploratory behavior
rationale: Members are species-typical behaviors (mating, aggression, parental care, grooming, exploration, locomotor activity) plus amygdala development, unlike confusables about drug responses, dopamine or neuropeptide signaling and sleep.

core: Hormonal and nuclear-receptor control of triglyceride metabolism
qualifier: glucagon-PKA and LXR
name: Glucagon-PKA and LXR regulation of triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members link glucagon/PKA/PDE3B and AMPK signaling with LXR-controlled lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis to set triglyceride and fatty acid balance, whereas confusables emphasize insulin secretion, glucose-ChREBP sensing, insulin action or adipocyte differentiation.

qualifier: carnitine, choline-trimethylamine, biotin and ubiquinol
name: Carnitine, choline-trimethylamine and biotin cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis/transport of carnitine, choline catabolism with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, biotin recycling and ubiquinol synthesis with their inborn errors, distinct from thiamin/riboflavin, B12 and amino-acid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
name: Adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis, lipid droplet dynamics, triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis with PPAR/ChREBP/LXR control, while confusables add insulin secretion and glucose uptake or lack the adipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet components.

qualifier: cochlear hair cell stereocilia
name: Cochlear hair cell stereocilia and sound mechanotransduction
rationale: All members concern sound detection by cochlear hair cells through stereocilia organization and mechanical transduction, distinct from photoreceptor, inner ear morphogenesis and vestibular confusables.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and polyol interconversion
name: Glycerol transport, polyol metabolism and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and polyol metabolism, aquaporin-mediated glycerol (and urea) transport, and PA/DAG/TAG synthesis; the glycerol transport branch separates it from lipid-droplet, lipolysis and fructose-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation and satellite cell activation
name: Positive regulation of myoblast differentiation and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast differentiation, fusion or skeletal muscle regeneration via satellite cell activation, whereas confusables cover negative regulation, proliferation, fate commitment, migration or atrophy.

qualifier: potassium channel-mediated repolarization and resting potential
name: Cardiac action potential repolarization by potassium channels
rationale: Members cover phases 1-4 of the cardiomyocyte action potential with Kir, TWIK and voltage-gated K+ channels and atrial/ventricular repolarization, distinguishing it from confusables on phase 0/pacemaker conduction, gap junctions and calcium-handling contraction.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical signaling
qualifier: PORCN-dependent biogenesis and WNT5A calcium pathway
name: Wnt ligand secretion and WNT5A non-canonical calcium signaling
rationale: Members concern WNT biogenesis/secretion (PORCN, its inhibitor) and the WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical branch, unlike confusables on Hedgehog lipidation, planar cell polarity or WNT5A-FZD4 vascular barrier signaling.

qualifier: non-histone substrates such as TP53
name: Peptidyl lysine and arginine methylation, including TP53
rationale: All members are protein lysine (mono/di/tri) or arginine methylation, including TP53 methylation, distinguishing it from histone/DNA methylation, hydroxylation and acetylation confusables.

core: p53 and G2 DNA-damage checkpoint control
qualifier: kinase signaling including AKT
name: Kinase control of p53 and G2 checkpoint, including AKT
rationale: Members link radiation-induced checkpoint signaling, p53 phosphorylation/degradation, Cdc25A turnover and mitotic re-entry with PI3K-AKT kinase signaling, whereas confusables focus on p53 transcriptional targets, G2/M cyclin events or p14ARF defects.

qualifier: selenocysteine synthesis and selenoprotein redox defense
name: Selenium metabolism and selenoprotein antioxidant redox defense
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and recoding, and the redox/ROS detoxification and protein repair selenoproteins perform, distinct from NADPH/ascorbate, glutathione/sulfur and thyroid hormone confusables.

qualifier: ER translocation, membrane insertion, folding and quality control
name: ER protein translocation, folding, quality control and Golgi export
rationale: Members span SRP and tail-anchored ER targeting, ER folding, ERAD/ERQC, ER retention and COPII/COPI ER-Golgi traffic, while confusables concentrate on Golgi/endosome vesicle traffic and Rab regulation.

qualifier: EXT1/EXT2 chain polymerization and exostoses
name: Heparan sulfate and heparin biosynthesis, EXT-linked exostoses
rationale: All members concern heparan sulfate/heparin proteoglycan synthesis including EXT1/EXT2 defects causing exostoses, distinct from chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, linkage-region and O-fucose/glucose glycosylation confusables.

qualifier: glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and vesicular loading
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members concern SLC transporter-mediated glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake, astrocytic uptake and vesicular loading with their transporter diseases, whereas confusables emphasize GABA synthesis/degradation and aspartate transport.

qualifier: APC/C phosphorylation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate turnover
name: APC/C phosphorylation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate turnover at mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C activation by phosphorylation and APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 degradation of Nek2A, cyclin A and Cdc20 during mitotic exit, distinct from confusables on cyclin B/securin degradation, Emi1 or APC/C inhibition.

qualifier: progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical lamination
name: Forebrain progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical lamination
rationale: Members cover neuroblast and radial glial division, radial/tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and forebrain commissures, while confusables emphasize dorsoventral patterning, spinal cord, reelin/dendrite or cerebellar layer formation.

qualifier: SUMO maturation and E1-E2 conjugation cascade
name: SUMO maturation, E1-E2 conjugation and substrate SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of replication, repair, RNA-binding, nuclear envelope and transcription factor substrates, distinguishing it from chromatin/cofactor SUMOylation, PML/nuclear transport and nuclear pore confusables.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1 processing
name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and pro-inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members concern NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity, IL-1 precursor processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, distinct from AIM2/pyroptosis/IL-18, negative cytokine regulation and chemokine confusables.
